text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for speed bumps on Azzarello Lane, between Craven Road and Rhodes Avenue. The assessment indicates that the eligibility criteria for the installation of speed bumps has not been satisfied. Therefore, staff do not recommend the installation of speed bumps in Azzarello Lane.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps on Azzarello Lane, between Craven Road and Rhodes Avenue, as shown on Drawing No. 421G-4221, dated September 2022, and attached to the report (January 10, 2023) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
